description: Header file defining validation and checking functions for C11 Annex K, including memory operations, error handling, backtrace, and assertions, with platform-specific configurations.

methods.name: ck_getenv_s
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value with size limit, storing length and value.

methods.name: ck_memclear_s
methods.description: Clears memory with a constant byte, similar to memset_s.

methods.name: ck_memzero
methods.description: Wrapper around ck_memclear_s to zero memory.

methods.name: ck_strerror_s
methods.description: Converts error number to string message.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time
methods.description: Performs constant-time memory comparison for equality.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time_fixed_len
methods.description: Performs constant-time memory comparison for fixed length data.

methods.name: ck_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory, aborts on failure.

methods.name: ck_realloc_u32
methods.description: Reallocates memory with size limit, aborts on failure.

methods.name: ck_assert_failed
methods.description: Handles failed assertions, printing message and aborting.
